website.note: Pipeline shows EB-003 (lead) and EVM401 series, both at preclinical / pre-IND stage.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Enveric is a preclinical-stage psychedelic-derivative neuroplastogen company. Lead asset EB-003 (DMT derivative from EVM301 Series, dual 5-HT2A/5-HT1B for depression/PTSD/anxiety) is at the IND-filing stage per the FY2025 10-K pipeline graphic. Secondary EVM401 Series (mescaline-derived phenylalkylamines) is at early research. No company-sponsored Phase 1/2/3 trials have been initiated; no records on ClinicalTrials.gov.

excluded_preclinical.indication: Opioid withdrawal, ADHD, anxiety, depression, SUD
